fields.description:
1 Currency = [?] Fraction
For e.g. 1 USD = 100 Cent

fields.label: Symbol
fields.description: A symbol for this currency. For e.g. $

fields.label: Show Currency Symbol on Right Side

fields.description: Official code assigned by the ONEI. Highly preferred. At least one of this or Internal Code is required.

fields.label: Internal Code
fields.description: Company's own proprietary code. Use only if the DUINE Code is not available. At least one of this or DUINE Code is required.

fields.label: Registration Details
fields.description: Company registration numbers for your reference. Tax numbers etc.

Enabling this option will allow you to record -

1. Advances Received in a Liability Account instead of the Asset Account

2. Advances Paid in an Asset Account instead of the Liability Account

fields.label: Reconcile on Advance Payment Date
fields.description:
If Enabled - Reconciliation happens on the Advance Payment posting date
If Disabled - Reconciliation happens on oldest of 2 Dates: Invoice Date or the Advance Payment posting date
